name: Survey Research
description: Design and analyze a survey with explicit population, sampling, measurement, fielding, quality controls, weighting, uncertainty, and reproducible reporting.

tasks.name: Define research design
tasks.objective: Specify decisions, constructs, target population, sampling frame, mode, sample-size rationale, subgroups, timing, privacy/consent, accessibility, and inferential limits.

tasks.name: Draft questionnaire
tasks.objective: Write neutral, single-purpose questions with appropriate reference periods, response options, scales, randomization/branching, demographic items only when justified, and clear skip logic.

tasks.name: Pretest and revise
tasks.objective: Use cognitive interviewing, pilot responses, completion timing, item nonresponse, routing checks, device/accessibility review, and open-text inspection to detect interpretation and usability problems.

tasks.name: Field with quality controls
tasks.objective: Execute sampling/contact plan, monitor response patterns, quotas or stratification where designed, duplicate/fraud indicators, straightlining/speeding signals, mode issues, and field changes.

tasks.name: Analyze and weight
tasks.objective: Clean according to predeclared rules, calculate weights where justified, estimate statistics with appropriate uncertainty/design effects, test subgroup claims carefully, and preserve wording/order context.

tasks.name: Publish transparent findings
tasks.objective: Report method, field dates, population/frame, sample disposition, questionnaire, weighting, uncertainty, limitations, toplines/crosstabs, reproducible analysis, and distinctions between descriptive and causal claims.
